trial_court: Family Court, Balasore, Case No. 306 of 2019
facts_of_case: Petitioner-husband filed for transfer of CP case pending in Family Court, Balasore. Respondent-wife is serving at Kolkata and has filed application for dissolution of marriage with petitioner.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the party seeking transfer of a proceeding to establish that the court in seisin is not well connected with the place where the opposite party resides.
legal_principles.held: Considering the submissions made and on going through the averments taken in the application, it is clear that the opposite party has failed to make out any case for transfer.

legal_principles.principle: A court's well connection with a place is not just physical proximity, but also includes connectivity by road and rail.
legal_principles.held: Balasore is at a distance of around 25 kms from the place of her service; whereas the petitioner is residing in the district of Jajpur which is at a distance of around 110 kms from the place where the court in seisin of the proceeding which is sought to be transferred situates and that is well communicated with Balasore both by road as well as rail.

use_for_drafting: drafting a petition for transfer of case
